text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This snack... Looks like something 
you'd like, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should try making some next 
time...? As a refreshment for work...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Together with... some coffee as well. 
Perhaps something rich and full-bodied 
would be nice...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This one looks delicious too... What 
should I do...? Which one do you prefer, 
Trainer...?

"Still in Love ended up staying up late 
because she was so engrossed in thinking 
about what snacks to bring."
